rx_launch.label: Prescription telehealth line goes live (model month)

posts_per_month.label: Brand posts per month by the partner (feed plus reels)

reach_pct.label: Reach per brand post as a share of followers

ctr_reach.label: Click-through to site per reached impression

attn_decay.label: Monthly decay of partner-driven traffic toward a floor

attn_floor.label: Floor for partner-driven traffic as a share of the launch peak

paid_pre.label: Paid media per month before the non-Rx launch

paid_floor.label: Minimum paid media per month after launch

paid_pct.label: Paid media as a share of prior-month net revenue

launch_push.label: One-time launch marketing and PR, non-Rx launch month

paid_elast.label: Paid response elasticity (sessions per marginal dollar)

cap_m1.label: Orders the supply chain can ship in the first live month

sub_attach.label: Share of new customers taking a subscription

onetime_repeat.label: Monthly reorder rate of one-time buyers

nonrx_cogs_pct.label: Landed product COGS as a share of retail

nonrx_fulfil.label: Pick, pack and ship per order (ambient)

eligible_rate.label: Share of completions with a clinically eligible outcome

state_cov_launch.label: US population covered by served states at Rx launch

intake_submit.label: Intake submission rate, eligible to intake

enroll_rate.label: Paid enrolment rate after a prescription is issued

refill_cost.label: Clinician cost per active member-month (monitoring and refill review)

coldchain_ship.label: Cold-chain fulfilment and shipping per fill

rx_support.label: Non-clinical support cost per active member-month

provider_fee.label: Turnkey compliance and fulfilment provider, flat fee

team_pre.label: Team per month before the non-Rx launch

team_p1.label: Team per month, non-Rx launch through month 12

med_lead.label: Medical director and clinical oversight per month

legal_p0.label: Legal and regulatory per month, months 1-4

legal_ongoing.label: Legal and compliance per month thereafter

insurance.label: Insurance per month from the non-Rx launch

creative.label: Creative, content and organic social per month

partner_cash.label: Partner cash retainer per month from the non-Rx launch

inv_months.label: Non-Rx inventory held, in months of COGS
